slice 1 shared scaffolding select_tools: ToolError (selection / brush / model_unavailable / tool_out_of_range), ToolLimits.max_work_bytes (default 256 MiB) admitted before allocation, Composite (stride/NaN/alpha-range checked), RgbaImage ROI copy, select_tools::DESCRIPTOR

slice 2 select_tools::quick: quick_select(layers, active, base, QuickStroke{samples, diameter_px, mode Add|Subtract}) - dabs by brush::place_dabs + stroke_coverage (hard round tip, 25 % spacing), ROI = footprint grown by roi_margin_px (default 3 d + 8), hard seeds (Add: stroke + base = fg; Subtract: stroke + unselected = bg), min-cut segmentation, combined with base by selection::combine Extend / Diminish; grabcut_rect(rect) rectangle-initialised GrabCut; GraphCutOptions{gamma 50, iterations 3, roi_margin_px, sample_merged, max_flow_steps}; select_tools::maxflow::FlowGraph Dinic (iterative DFS, current-arc, arc-scan budget, source_side min cut); object_select / subject_select / sky_select -> model_unavailable

slice 3 select_tools::refine::refine_edge (STU-RAS-121 controls): radius band from an exact Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher EDT (distance - 0.5 < radius), smart_radius (band * (0.25 + 0.75 (1 - s)), s = max over the band window of 3x3 step / band-window colour range), smooth (majority vote), feather (selection::feather), contrast, shift_edge (a^(2^(-s/50))), decontaminate_colours + amount; matte = He et al. 2010 colour guided filter or Levin et al. 2008 closed-form matting by conjugate gradients with the He et al. 2010 matrix-free Laplacian; RefineOutput{coverage, band_pixels, colours}; MatteMethod, RefineOptions (window_radius, epsilon, lambda, max_iterations, max_ops, sample_merged)

slice 4 pigment::liquify::LiquifyMesh: re-editable backward displacement mesh (serde + validate), tools forward_warp, push_left, twirl cw/ccw, pucker, bloat, reconstruct, smooth composed as D'(p) = q + D(q) - p; dabs from brush::place_dabs (10 % spacing, held pen = one stationary application per sample); LiquifyBrush{size, density, pressure, rate} (no clamping); freeze/thaw from a CoveragePlane; render through transform_math::PreparedTransform per pixel (nearest|bilinear|bicubic): identity, reconstruct_all and full-strength reconstruct brush are byte copies

slice 5 pigment::smart_filter::SmartFilterStack: entries (filter_math LayerFilter or liquify mesh) with enabled, opacity, per-entry coverage mask and stack mask, re-rendered from the untouched source in list order, premultiplied mix (weight 0/1 exact bytes); every entry validated before any filter runs

slice 6 harness view::select_liquify (feature viewer): Viewer::select_wand / select_quick (layer tiles read in sRGB display encoding, pigment tools, combine, marching ants; one selection-history step each: undo_selection, selection_steps) and Viewer::liquify (one stroke on a raster layer through the pigment mesh + resampler; changed tile bodies staged and committed as ONE chronicle tiles edit -> undo/redo); view/mod.rs module line + selection_history field

notes.measured_bounds: select_quick on 64x64 synthetic images with +-0.04 deterministic noise: quick add IoU vs disk 1.0000 (asserted >= 0.95), quick subtract IoU vs kept half 1.0000 (asserted >= 0.98), grabcut_rect IoU vs disk 1.0000 (asserted >= 0.95); Dinic on CLRS fig 26.1 = 23 with min cut {s,v1,v2,v4}. select_refine on I = alpha F + (1 - alpha) B with an 8 px linear ramp: closed-form max |alpha - truth| 0.00025 (asserted < 0.02), guided filter band mean |alpha - truth| 0.0638 vs 0.1667 for the hard selection (asserted < 0.08 and < half), decontaminated band colour max |c - F| 0.0843 (asserted < 0.15), band pixels hard step 512 -> smart 128 (exact), ramp smart 448. liquify: 4.8 px forward warp moves the line peak to x = 24 (pixels 24 and 25 exactly red), rows outside the brush byte-identical, reconstruct exact identity bytes for nearest/bilinear/bicubic, hand geometry for bloat/pucker/twirl/push-left/smooth to 1e-12 / 1e-9. smart_filter: full-strength stack == sequential filter_plane bytes; masked halves exact bytes.
